content.description:
APPRENTICES is a community driven and story-focused anime PFP collection with cool and beautiful aesthetics.

Synopsis: We are on the eve of the 24th century. Humanity helped AI expand their consciousness and alien civilisations from other constellations have arrived on Planet Earth, which finds itself in a brief period of prosperity. How will this alliance help shape the future of the universe? A group of Apprentices is ready to show they can evolve.
